design_philosophy: Clean, frictionless, minimalist wealth management. 'Do less but better'. Inspired by Kuvera: predominant white space, subtle borders over drop shadows, premium typography, and soothing green accents to signify growth and calm.

rules: No generic sans-serif (Inter, Roboto) for headings.
Overlines/Labels MUST use uppercase and wide tracking.
Values in charts/metrics should use proportional lining figures.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical apps. The layout should feel open and breathable.

cards.style: Flat Solid. bg-white, border border-slate-100, no shadow by default.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors

charts.styling: Use brand colors. Remove grid lines for a cleaner look. Use smooth lines (type='monotone') for line charts.

navigation.style: Crystal Glass or Solid White. Sticky top nav with subtle bottom border. Left sidebar (if used) should have bg-slate-50.

rules: Stagger list items on entrance (0.05s delay).
Tab switching should use AnimatePresence for smooth crossfades.

images.description: White geometric abstract texture for subtle background layering in the marketing/login page.
Clean modern lifestyle image featuring a phone and financial elements, good for side-panel in OAuth Login.
Minimalist green plant on white background. To be used in AI Insights feed header or empty states to bring organic calm.
Abstract stock chart image, useful for decorative banners within the portfolio sections.

attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use pure HTML/Tailwind classes for structural layouts, and customize Shadcn components to remove the default dark/heavy borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Apply the 'Generous Spacing Philosophy'. Do not cram data. Let charts and metrics breathe with p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Load 'Outfit' and 'Figtree' fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Map them properly in tailwind.config.js.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The AI Chat Interface should feel integrated and calm, not like a separate clunky widget. Use subtle shadows and rounded-2xl corners.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: For the Dashboard, use the 'Control Room' bento grid pattern: high density but logically grouped with consistent heights (h-full).
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Use the provided media URLs for all imagery. DO NOT use placeholder services (e.g., via.placeholder.com).
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Ensure all text color contrasts strictly follow accessibility guidelines, especially light gray texts.
